phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Custom error types provide meaningful error messages.**

**Custom error features:**

| Feature | Why |
|---------|-----|
| `Display` | User-friendly messages |
| `Debug` | Developer-friendly |
| `Error` | Compatible with std |
| `From` | Automatic conversion |
| `type Result<T> = Result<T, MyError>` | Type alias |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Custom errors make your code more maintainable."

**When to use custom errors:**
| Situation | Use custom errors |
|-----------|-------------------|
| Multiple error types | ✅ |
| Domain-specific errors | ✅ |
| Library code | ✅ |
| Large projects | ✅ |
